label.purpose: Dates, folios, counts, tabs and filters.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One authored entrance for the newest print.

components.name: Ink link
components.description: Red underlined action, never a filled button.
components.css: .ds-ink-link { background: transparent; color: #bf2f1e; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #bf2f1e; padding: 6px 0; font: 500 .75rem/1.4 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ink-link:hover { color: #962617; border-bottom-color: #962617; } .ds-ink-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bf2f1e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active tab
components.description: Uppercase tab with a red underline when active.
components.css: .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: #6a655e; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; min-width: 56px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 6px; font: 500 .75rem 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #161514; border-bottom-color: #bf2f1e; }

components.name: Filter
components.description: Text-only dish filter with a tabular count.
components.css: .ds-filter { background: transparent; color: #6a655e; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 0; font: 500 .75rem 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #bf2f1e; border-bottom-color: #bf2f1e; } .ds-filter b { font-weight: 400; margin-left: 8px; }

components.name: Plate label
components.description: Red plate number overlapping a white photo mount.
components.css: .ds-plate-label { display: inline-block; background: #bf2f1e; color: #fff; font: 500 .62rem 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .10em; padding: 5px 9px; }

components.name: Dish mark
components.description: Red for Zhujiaofan, ink for Shaorou.
components.css: .ds-dish-mark { display: inline-block; border-bottom: 2px solid #bf2f1e; color: #bf2f1e; font: 500 .75rem 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .10em; text-transform: uppercase; padding-bottom: 3px; } .ds-dish-mark--crisp { border-bottom-color: #161514; color: #161514; }

components.name: Photo mount
components.description: White paper around every photograph, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-mount { position: relative; display: block; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d5cfc4; padding: 14px; } .ds-mount img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 300px; object-fit: cover; background: #e4e0d6; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: A single ruled input on the map list.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #161514; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #bdb5a7; padding: 9px 0; font: 400 .8rem/1.5 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; caret-color: #bf2f1e; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #6a655e; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #bf2f1e; }

narrative.overview: A serious broadsheet that happens to be about dinner. Newsprint ground, white photo mounts, black ink, one red rule. The page is set, not decorated: hairlines divide, dates are tabular, and the only saturated colour is a single vermilion used for marks and actions. Food photography carries every bit of warmth the page has.
keyCharacteristics: Newsprint ground, white mounts, black ink, one vermilion signal.
Taviraj for display, Noto Sans Thai for reading and labels, both with Thai and Latin subsets.
Square corners, one-pixel rules, no shadows.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks a state or an action. It never fills a large area and never appears twice as decoration in the same component.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Photographs sit on white paper. The ground is newsprint. They must never share a surface.

rules.name: The Two-Script Rule
rules.body: Every type role uses a face with real Thai glyphs. Latin and Thai never fall back to different families, and no role uses a system display face.

dos: Do keep the red to marks and actions; one red per component.
Do mount every photograph on white paper with a plate number.
Do keep the print strip inside the first desktop viewport.
Do keep all controls at least 44px with a visible red focus ring.
donts: Don't add cards, shadows, rounded panels, gradients, or glass.
Don't use a second accent colour; ink is a neutral mark.
Don't swap in a font without Thai glyphs for any type role.
Don't invent shops, photographs, ratings, or prices.
